Human Mortality Database tables

Source: R/data-adapters.R
mt_from_hmd.Rd

mt_from_hmd() converts HMD tables in the layout returned by HMDHFDplus::readHMDweb() (columns Year, Age, Female, Male, Total, and OpenInterval) into an mt_data object with strata sex. Without column OpenInterval, an age written with + ("110+") is the open interval. mt_read_hmd() downloads Deaths_1x1 and Exposures_1x1 for one country with HMDHFDplus; an HMD account is needed (https://www.mortality.org).

Usage

mt_from_hmd(deaths, exposures, sexes = c("Female", "Male"), years = NULL)

mt_read_hmd(
  country,
  username = Sys.getenv("HMD_USER"),
  password = Sys.getenv("HMD_PASSWORD"),
  years = NULL
)

Arguments

deaths, exposures

Data frames from HMDHFDplus::readHMDweb().

sexes

Columns to use.

years

Optional subset of years.

country

HMD country code, for example "SWE".

username, password

HMD credentials (default: environment variables HMD_USER and HMD_PASSWORD).

Value

An mt_data object.

Examples

d <- data.frame(Year = 2000, Age = 0:2, Female = c(10, 1, 1), Male = c(12, 2, 1),
                Total = c(22, 3, 2), OpenInterval = c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE))
e <- transform(d, Female = 1000, Male = 1000, Total = 2000)
mt_from_hmd(d, e)
#> <mt_data> 2 strata by sex, omega = 110
#>   deaths     single years 0-1, 2+; periods 2000-2000 (width 1); 6 cells
#>   exposure   single years 0-1, 2+; periods 2000-2000 (width 1); 6 cells
#>   grid       <mt_axis: age, 3 intervals> 0 1 2+
#>              <mt_axis: period, 1 interval> 2000
